title: P0.35: Observation permission grant must unblock the immediate retry
description: Live runtime proof showed that after the user granted ChatGPT observation permission, the next external consultation still blocked on the old permission_required snapshot. The permission registry was updated, but current_model() decorated and returned stale permission gates, detected_blocks, and block_records until a later full scan.
resume_hint: Implemented locally in WorldModelService._decorate_snapshot(): live granted observation scopes now override stale permission gates, tool permission_state, permission_required detected_blocks, and permission_required block_records without waiting for a full rescan.
